name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Sicilian goes with either Mikhail or 1696 (but not both).

The Sicilian player's rating is between the Pirc player and Nadia.
Exactly one of these is true: Garry goes with Slav; Mikhail goes with Pirc; Caro-Kann goes with 1696.
The Sicilian player's rating is higher than both Anatoly and the Pirc player.
